title: Value after moving the input head
statement: For natural numbers $N,p$ with $p<N+2$, and for a movement sign $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, the value of the resulting input-head position is $p$ when $m=0$, $\min(p+1,N+1)$ when $m=1$, and $p-1$ when $m=-1$.
